description: This file defines API endpoints for managing development plans in a FastAPI application, including creating, retrieving, and exporting plans.

classes.name: DevelopmentPlan
classes.description: A schema representing a development plan with steps.

classes.name: PlanExportRequest
classes.description: Schema for request to export a development plan.

classes.name: PlanExportResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after exporting a plan, typically containing a URL.

classes.name: GapAnalysisRequest
classes.description: Schema for request containing gap analysis input data.

classes.name: GapAnalysisResult
classes.description: Schema representing the result of a gap analysis.

methods.name: DevelopmentPlan generate_plan( payload: GapAnalysisRequest, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session), user=Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Asynchronous endpoint to generate a personalized development plan based on gap analysis input.

methods.name: DevelopmentPlan get_plan_placeholder(_: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Asynchronous endpoint that provides a placeholder plan, used as a stub.

methods.name: PlanExportResponse export_plan( payload: PlanExportRequest, user=Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Asynchronous endpoint to export a development plan, returning a shareable link.

calls: log_action(session=session, user_id=user.id, action="development-plan-generate", entity_type="Role", entity_id=payload.targetRoleId, details={"steps": len(plan.steps)})

ctags.name: generate_plan
ctags.signature: ( payload: GapAnalysisRequest, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session), user=Depends(get_current_user), )
